query.en: Turn my recipe into a 3-card square Instagram carousel. Card 1 is a dark brown cover with a simple flat illustration of the dish, the name in a chunky serif, one tempting line and three numbers (makes, prep, bake). Card 2 lists the ingredients with amounts aligned right and one tip. Card 3 is the numbered method with my handle at the bottom. Warm cream, brown and butter-yellow. Use my recipe exactly; don't change quantities or add steps.
